meta.name: codebase-design
meta.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计深度模块的共享词汇，改善接口与可测试性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在设计或改进模块接口，寻找深化机会
copy.tagline_en: Design deep modules with shared vocabulary for better interfaces and testability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or improving module interfaces and seeking deepening opportunities

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用一套专业术语（如模块、接口、深度、接缝）来帮你设计或改进代码模块。它会分析模块的接口是否简洁、内部逻辑是否隐藏，并给出让模块更易测试、更易维护的建议。
howto.when: 当你询问如何设计或改进一个模块的接口、寻找代码的拆分点、想让代码更易测试，或者需要评估模块的“深度”时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个函数接口是否太复杂？
say.note: Claude 会评估接口的深度并提出简化建议。

say.text: 这个模块的接缝应该放在哪里？
say.note: Claude 会帮你确定模块接口的放置位置。

say.text: 如何让这段代码更容易测试？
say.note: Claude 会应用测试性设计原则给出建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses a shared vocabulary (module, interface, depth, seam) to help you design or improve code modules. It analyzes whether the interface is small and the implementation deep, and gives advice on making modules more testable and maintainable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about designing or improving a module's interface, finding where to place a seam, making code more testable, or evaluating module depth.

say_en.text: Analyze if this function interface is too complex.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate interface depth and suggest simplifications.

say_en.text: Where should the seam for this module be?
say_en.note: Claude will help determine the placement of the module's interface.

say_en.text: How can I make this code more testable?
say_en.note: Claude will apply testability design principles.
